settings.hero_body: When someone comes to mind, a thoughtful little collection can carry the message further. Eight soft companions give your thinking-of-you gesture a place in their everyday life.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Turn the thought into a gesture.
settings.final_body: Choose the complete crew for someone you would like to make smile.
settings.moods_title: A whole crew to send their way.
settings.moods_body: All eight pictured companions are included.
settings.personality_title: A reminder they can put on the shelf.
settings.personality_body: Choose the set because it feels like them, then add your own words with a card. Cards and gift wrapping are not included with the plush collection.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: A reminder they can put on the shelf.
